toegepas.voor: Om vuil water skoon te maak is twee verskillende werke.
toegepas.na: Om vuil water skoon te maak, is twee verskillende take.
toegepas.rede_vinder: 'Werke' for jobs/tasks reads as 'works' (as in waterwerke); 'take' is the natural word, and a comma after the opening om...te clause separates it from the verb.
toegepas.fout: 'werke' for tasks is unnatural and reads as 'works', colliding with 'waterwerke' in the same lesson
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'take' is the natural Afrikaans word for jobs to be done, the comma after the opening om...te clause is allowed, and the meaning is unchanged.

toegepas.voor: Die kleurstof het opgelos en sy deeltjies
toegepas.na: Die kleurstof het opgelos, en sy deeltjies
toegepas.rede_vinder: AWS comma before 'en' joining two clauses that each have their own subject and verb.
toegepas.fout: missing AWS comma before 'en' joining two clauses with their own subject and verb
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'Die kleurstof het opgelos' and 'sy deeltjies is te klein' are two full clauses, so the AWS 2017 requires the comma.

toegepas.voor: kan ook kieme in water doodmaak en die waterwerke
toegepas.na: kan ook kieme in water doodmaak, en die waterwerke
toegepas.rede_vinder: AWS comma before 'en' joining two clauses that each have their own subject and verb.
toegepas.fout: missing AWS comma before 'en' joining two clauses with their own subject and verb
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'n Chemikalie kan ... doodmaak' and 'die waterwerke gebruik gewoonlik chloor' are two full clauses, the comma is required, and 'gewoonlik' is untouched.

toegepas.blok: Die waterwerke: voordat ons die water gebruik
toegepas.voor: 'n Sif vang eers die groot goed en dan staan
toegepas.na: 'n Sif vang eers die groot stukke, en dan staan
toegepas.rede_vinder: 'Die groot goed' is loose and colloquial; 'groot stukke' matches the sieve block and definition, and the AWS comma goes before 'en' joining two clauses with their own subjects.
toegepas.fout: 'die groot goed' is loose and colloquial, and the AWS comma before 'en dan staan die water' is missing
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'groot stukke' matches the sieve block and definition without changing meaning, and the second clause has its own subject and verb, so the comma is required.

toegepas.voor: Jy oordeel watter filter beter werk aan hoe helder die water uitkom.
toegepas.na: Jy oordeel watter filter beter werk deur te kyk hoe helder die water uitkom.
toegepas.rede_vinder: 'Oordeel ... aan hoe' strands the preposition after the embedded question and reads awkwardly; 'deur te kyk hoe' is clear and keeps the meaning.
toegepas.fout: 'oordeel ... aan hoe helder' is an awkward, un-Afrikaans construction that makes a reader stumble
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'deur te kyk hoe helder' is clear, natural Grade 6 Afrikaans and keeps the same test of judging by clarity.

laat_vaar.blok: Vier maniere om water helderder te maak
laat_vaar.voor: lap of sand. Stukkies wat te groot is vir die gaatjies bly agter.
laat_vaar.na: lap of sand. Stukkies wat te groot is vir die gaatjies, bly agter.
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: A comma after the embedded relative clause keeps 'is' and 'bly' from colliding; optional under the AWS, so the reviewer may prefer to match the decided filtreer definition, which has none.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: The comma is optional, the sentence reads cleanly without it, and leaving it out keeps the sentence in step with the decided filtreer definition.

na_skrywer.rede_vinder: 'Soos die pakkie sê' calques 'as the packet says'; 'soos op die pakkie staan' is the idiomatic Afrikaans.
na_skrywer.fout: 'soos die pakkie se' is a mild calque of 'as the packet says'
na_skrywer.rede_keurder: The fix is better Afrikaans, but the sentence tells an adult how to dose a chemical, which is a safety instruction the writer owns.
na_skrywer.waarom: the reviewer sent it to the writer

na_skrywer.rede_vinder: The protected-word reasons say 'die kieme' reads as all germs; dropping the article matches the lesson's own protected wording 'maak kieme dood' without changing the point.
na_skrywer.fout: 'die kieme' can read as all germs, which the lesson's own protected-word ruling warns against
na_skrywer.rede_keurder: Dropping the article weakens what the sentence claims about killing germs, so it is a content qualifier the writer must settle rather than a language edit.
na_skrywer.waarom: the reviewer sent it to the writer

na_skrywer.rede_vinder: The protected-word reasons say 'die kieme' reads as all germs and the lesson must never imply all germs; 'maak kieme dood' is the protected wording.
na_skrywer.fout: 'maak wel die kieme dood' can read as killing all germs, against the lesson's own protected-word ruling
na_skrywer.rede_keurder: Removing the article changes how much the sentence claims boiling and chlorine achieve, so the writer must decide it as content.
na_skrywer.waarom: the reviewer sent it to the writer

vlae.rede: If 'werke' becomes 'take' in the opening sentence, the block heading should change to 'Twee verskillende take' to match; the heading's text also occurs in the sentence, so it was not proposed as a separate change.
